meta.name: WizzardModule
meta.label: Wizzarding World
meta.description: Module to cast Harry Potter spells.

no_permission.label: Message - No Permission
no_permission.description: Sent when user or bot lacks permission.

missing_args.label: Message - Missing Arguments
missing_args.description: Sent when arguments are missing (e.g., mention).

aberto.name: Aberto
aberto.description: Spell specific to the Fantastic Beasts film.

accio.name: Accio
accio.description: From the Latin verb accire, accio would mean “I make someone come to me”.

aguamenti.name: Aguamenti
aguamenti.description: Aguamenti is derived from the Spanish agua meaning "water" and the Latin mens (menti in the dative case) meaning "spirit", which would make aguamenti an invocation of the "spirit of water".

alohomora.name: Alohomora
alohomora.description: According to Blandine Le Callet, author of the book The Ancient World of Harry Potter, Alohomora may be derived from the Hawaiian word aloha, which means both "hello" and "goodbye", and the Latin mora which means "obstacle".

amplificatum.name: Amplificatum
amplificatum.description: It increases the size of the object or animal targeted, a priori, it would seem that it is the force-feeding or stuffing spell (from which Hagrid's pumpkins in Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets would have benefited).

anapneo.name: Anapneo
anapneo.description: Greek neologism from the prefix ana- which means “again” and pneô which means “I breathe”.

apparevestigium.name: Appare vestigium
apparevestigium.description: Spell specific to the film Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald.

araniaexumai.name: Arania exumai
araniaexumai.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets.

arrestomomentum.name: Arresto momentum
arrestomomentum.description: Spell specific to the Harry Potter films.

ascendio.name: Ascendio
ascendio.description: Derived from the Latin ascendo (“I ascend”), from the verb ascendere.

assurdiato.name: Assurdiato
assurdiato.description: Derived from the Latin verb surdare (“to make deaf”) for the French version.

avadakedavra.name: Avada Kedavra
avadakedavra.description: It instantly kills the targeted person.

avensegium.name: Avensegium
avensegium.description: Spell specific to the film Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald.

bloclang.name: Bloclang
bloclang.description: This curse is used to make people let go or open bonds (for example handcuffs).

bombardamaxima.name: Bombarda (maxima)
bombardamaxima.description: Spell specific to the Harry Potter films.

brachialigo.name: Brachialigo
brachialigo.description: Spell specific to the play Harry Potter and the Cursed Child.

brachiumemendo.name: Brachium emendo
brachiumemendo.description: From the Latin brachium (“the arm”) and emendare (“heal”, “rectify”, “straighten”).

caveinimicum.name: Cave inimicum
caveinimicum.description: Comes from the imperative of the Latin verb cavere, meaning “to take care of,” and the accusative of inimicus, meaning “the enemy.”

circumrota.name: Circumrota
circumrota.description: Spell specific to the film Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald.

capaciousextremis.name: Capacious extremis
capaciousextremis.description: This spell increases the storage capacity of an item.

cistemaperio.name: Cistem aperio
cistemaperio.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets.

collaporta.name: Collaporta
collaporta.description: It allows you to close and lock a door, producing a sucking sound.

confringo.name: Confringo
confringo.description: First person conjugated form of the Latin verb confringere (“to break”).

confundo.name: Confundo
confundo.description: Means in Latin “I trouble”, “I mix” or “I confuse”, from the verb confundere.

slugvomitingcharm.name: Slug-vomiting Charm
slugvomitingcharm.description: It triggers a scream if a person enters the area protected by the spell.

defodio.name: Defodio
defodio.description: From the Latin verb fodere (“to dig”), associated with the prefix de qui reinforces the meaning.

deprimo.name: Deprimo
deprimo.description: From the Latin verb deprimere (“to dig”).

dentesaugmento.name: Dentesaugmento
dentesaugmento.description: It causes the target person's teeth to grow excessively until the curse is canceled.

destructum.name: Destructum
destructum.description: Past participle of the Latin verb destruere (“to destroy”).

diffindo.name: Diffindo
diffindo.description: First person singular conjugation of the Latin verb diffindere, meaning “to split,” “to break,” or “to divide.”

emancipare.name: Emancipare
emancipare.description: Spell specific to the play Harry Potter and the Cursed Child.

endoloris.name: Endoloris
endoloris.description: The Crucio spell, triggered by the Crucio formula, causes the targeted being (person or animal) to feel unbearable pain.

enervatum.name: Enervatum
enervatum.description: The term translated into French by Jean-François Ménard, Enervatum (in the original version Rennervate), is a derivative of the Latin verb enervare which is composed of nervus (“the nerve”, “the muscle”, “the tendon”) and the privative prefix e-.

episkey.name: Episkey
episkey.description: Episkey is a derivative of the Greek verb episkeuazein, meaning “to repair” or “to restore.”

erigo.name: Erigo
erigo.description: Erigo (Erecto in English) is the Latin and first person conjugation of the verb erigere ("to raise", "to raise" or "to erect").

evanesco.name: Evanesco
evanesco.description: Evanesco, from the Latin verb evanescere, means “I disappear” or “I make disappear.”

evertestatum.name: Everte statum
evertestatum.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets.

expectopatronum.name: Expecto Patronum
expectopatronum.description: Spell specific to the Harry Potter films.

expelliarmus.name: Expelliarmus
expelliarmus.description: Composed of the Latin verb expellere (“to drive away”, “to drive away”) and the Latin word armus (“the weapon”).

expulso.name: Expulso
expulso.description: Composed of the Latin words ex (“out of”) and pulso (“I push,” “I strike,” “I collide”).

fenestra.name: Fenestra
fenestra.description: Spell specific to the Fantastic Beasts film.

failamalle.name: Failamalle
failamalle.description: He puts away the targeted objects.

fiantoduri.name: Fianto Duri
fiantoduri.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows, part 2.

fidelitas.name: Fidelitas
fidelitas.description: It neutralizes the influence of certain spells on an object or a person.

finiteincantatem.name: Finite Incantatem
finiteincantatem.description: Finite is the imperative form of the Latin verb finire, and means “to cause to cease”, “to stop”.

flambios.name: Flambios
flambios.description: This French translation is composed of the verb “flamber”, derived from the Latin verb flammare (“to ignite”, “to flamboyate”).

fulgari.name: Fulgari
fulgari.description: Spell specific to the play Harry Potter and the Cursed Child.

gemino.name: Gemino
gemino.description: Coming from the Latin verb geminare, Gemino means “I split”.

glisseo.name: Glisseo
glisseo.description: Glisseo (same in the original version) is derived from the French verb "glisser", to which J.

harmonianecterepassus.name: Harmonia nectere passus
harmonianecterepassus.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince.

hominumrevelio.name: Hominum revelio
hominumrevelio.description: Hominum is a fanciful form of the Latin word homo (genitive hominis), meaning “man.”

homomorphus.name: Homomorphus
homomorphus.description: Composed, in French as in the original version, of the Latin word homo (“man”) and the Greek word morphê meaning “form”.

impedimenta.name: Impedimenta
impedimenta.description: Derived from the Latin word impedimentum (“that which prevents”, or “hinders”), from the verb impedire (“to hinder”, “to embarrass”).

impero.name: Impero
impero.description: Imperium, which in Latin means "authority", "power" or "empire", has the formula Impero, which means "I order", "I oblige" or "I force".

immobulus.name: Immobulus
immobulus.description: Spell specific to the films Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets and Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban.

impervius.name: Impervius
impervius.description: Impervius, which in Latin means "inaccessible", "impenetrable", has the effect of repelling substances such as water from a surface.

incarcerem.name: Incarcerem
incarcerem.description: Composed of the Latin word in (“in”) and carcerem, the accusative of the Latin word carcer which means “prison”.

incendio.name: Incendio
incendio.description: Formed from the Latin incendo which means “I set fire”, “I light” (from the verb incendere).

lacarnuminflammari.name: Lacarnum inflammari
lacarnuminflammari.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone.

legilimens.name: Legilimens
legilimens.description: The English term legilimency is a neologism formed from the Latin verb legere, which means "to read", and the word mens (mentis in the genitive case) which means "the mind".

levicorpus.name: Levicorpus
levicorpus.description: Composed of the Latin adjective levis (“light”) and corpus (“the body”).

liberacorpus.name: Liberacorpus
liberacorpus.description: Composed of the imperative of the Latin verb liberare (“to liberate”) and corpus (“the body”).

locomotorbarda.name: Locomotor Barda
locomotorbarda.description: Derived from the Latin words locus (“the place”, “the place”) and motor, derived from the verb movere, meaning “to move”.

locomotormortis.name: Locomotor Mortis
locomotormortis.description: Derived from the Latin words locus (“the place”, “the place”) and motor, derived from the verb movere, meaning “to move”.

locomotorwibbly.name: Locomotor Wibbly
locomotorwibbly.description: Derived from the Latin word lumen meaning “light.”

meteorribilisrecanto.name: Meteorribilis Recanto
meteorribilisrecanto.description: Meteorribilis Recanto (Meteolojinx recanto in the original version) allows you to stop magical bad weather due to a faulty atmospheric spell.

mobiliarbus.name: Mobiliarbus
mobiliarbus.description: The formula consists of the Latin words mobilis (“mobile”) and arbor, “tree”.

mobilicorpus.name: Mobilicorpus
mobilicorpus.description: The formula consists of the Latin words mobilis (“mobile”) and corpus, “the body”.

molliare.name: Molliare
molliare.description: Spell specific to the play Harry Potter and the Cursed Child.

morsmordre.name: Morsmordre
morsmordre.description: It allows Death Eaters to summon the Dark Mark.

mutinlutinmalinpesti.name: Mutinlutin Malinpesti
mutinlutinmalinpesti.description: Magic formula intended to stop Cornish leprechauns, according to Gilderoy Lockhart.

nebulus.name: Nebulus
nebulus.description: Spell specific to the film Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald.

nox.name: Nox
nox.description: It allows you to cancel the Lumos spell.

obscuro.name: Obscuro
obscuro.description: Turns the targeted person or object black or prevents them from seeing.

oppugno.name: Oppugno
oppugno.description: He orders small, previously created birds to swoop down and attack a target.

orchideus.name: Orchideus
orchideus.description: He brings out a bouquet of flowers.

oscausi.name: Oscausi
oscausi.description: Spell specific to the film Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald.

oubliettes.name: Oubliettes
oubliettes.description: An amnesia spell, it erases or modifies a person's memory.

partistemporus.name: Partis Temporus
partistemporus.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince.

periculum.name: Periculum
periculum.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire.

petrificustotalus.name: Petrificus Totalus
petrificustotalus.description: It completely immobilizes and stiffens the targeted person.

piertotumlocomotor.name: Piertotum Locomotor
piertotumlocomotor.description: Spell that animates statues and armor.

portus.name: Portus
portus.description: It transforms an object into a Portkey.

priorincanto.name: Prior Incanto
priorincanto.description: It reveals the last spell(s), spells or curses cast by a wand.

prioriincantatum.name: Priori Incantatum
prioriincantatum.description: Can be launched automatically when two magic wands possessing - which is very rare - the same internal constituent element are forced by their owner to oppose each other in a duel.

protego.name: Protego
protego.description: Allows you to transform a Firecracker Scrout into a rubber duck in the presence of water.

protegodiabolica.name: Protego Diabolica
protegodiabolica.description: Spell specific to the film Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald.

protegototalum.name: Protego Totalum
protegototalum.description: This protection spell aims to protect something large, like a tent, a house.

protegohorribilis.name: Protego Horribilis
protegohorribilis.description: This protection spell aims to protect something very large like a castle or land.

recurvite.name: Recurvite
recurvite.description: This spell cleans, as its name suggests, quickly.

reducto.name: Reducto
reducto.description: Reduction spell, it reduces the size, volume of an object.

reparo.name: Reparo
reparo.description: Repair spell, it allows you to repair an object.

repellomoldum.name: Repello Moldum
repellomoldum.description: Muggle repellent spell, it allows you to keep muggles away from an area.

repelloinimicium.name: Repello Inimicium
repelloinimicium.description: Allows you to repel or eliminate (depending on the power of the spell) the enemies of the author of the spell entering an area defined by the latter.

reverte.name: Reverte
reverte.description: Spell specific to the film Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald.

revigor.name: Revigor
revigor.description: It restores some energy to the weak, stunned or unconscious target.

revelio.name: Revelio
revelio.description: Spell specific to the Fantastic Beasts film.

rictusempra.name: Rictusempra
rictusempra.description: A tickle curse, it causes the target to have an uncontrollable urge to laugh.

riddikulus.name: Riddikulus
riddikulus.description: This spell is useful for defeating a boggart.

salveomaleficia.name: Salveo Maleficia
salveomaleficia.description: It is a protective spell that protects against curses, surfaces and makes one's position invisible (Hermione uses it in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows).

sectumsempra.name: Sectumsempra
sectumsempra.description: It creates deep cuts in the target's body, which can very quickly bleed out.

serpensortia.name: Serpensortia
serpensortia.description: He makes a snake emerge at the end of the wand.

silencio.name: Silencio
silencio.description: A person affected by this spell becomes incapable of emitting the slightest sound.

sonorus.name: Sonorus
sonorus.description: It significantly increases the power and range of the voice.

surdinam.name: Surdinam
surdinam.description: It allows you to cancel Sonorus.

surgito.name: Surgito
surgito.description: Spell specific to the film Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald.

specialisrevelio.name: Specialis Revelio
specialisrevelio.description: It allows you to know the components of a potion.

speropatronum.name: Spero Patronum
speropatronum.description: This spell is specific to the French version of the novels and is equivalent to the Expecto Patronum spell (original and cinematographic version).

stupefix.name: Stupefix
stupefix.description: The target enters a very coma-like daze.

tarentallegra.name: Tarentallegra
tarentallegra.description: The target's legs begin to shake uncontrollably.

tergeo.name: Tergeo
tergeo.description: It cleans the intended target (removes in particular dried blood).

ventus.name: Ventus
ventus.description: Spell specific to the film Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald.

veraverto.name: Vera Verto
veraverto.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets.

viperaevanesca.name: Vipera Evanesca
viperaevanesca.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets.

volateascendere.name: Volate Ascendere
volateascendere.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets.

vulnerasanentur.name: Vulnera Sanentur
vulnerasanentur.description: Spell specific to the film Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince.

waddiwasi.name: Waddiwasi
waddiwasi.description: It allows you to move something at the speed of a bullet.

wingardiumleviosa.name: Wingardium leviosa
wingardiumleviosa.description: It allows you to levitate objects and move them as you wish.
